ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-contrast distribution with approximately 40% high-intensity (white) and 60% low-intensity (black) pixel coverage across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large central black mass originating at the notch and extending into the medial region of the left lobe. Distinct white distal regions on both lobes. Fine black mottling and stippling along the entire trailing edge boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an estimated interior angle of 88 degrees; vertex partially obscured by water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous micro-serration map along the trailing edge with peak amplitudes of 2-5 pixels; more pronounced jagged profile on the distal third of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe exhibits a smooth convex sweep. Right lobe follows a flatter convex trajectory with a terminal upward curvature at the distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, high-intensity pixel blobs localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense barnacle colonization at lobe terminals. No visible major amputations or deep tissue trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Single isolated dark focal spot located in the lower-left quadrant of the left lobe white distal region.
